cards.example_en: The signs warn cyclists about the narrow bridge ahead.
cards.example_zh: 这些标志警告骑车的人前方有一座窄桥。

cards.example_en: Children wash their hands before they cut the apples.
cards.example_zh: 孩子们在切苹果之前先把手洗干净。

cards.example_en: Don't waste the evening watching TV.
cards.example_zh: 不要把晚上的时间浪费在看电视上。

cards.example_en: We watch the fireworks from the school rooftop.
cards.example_zh: 我们从学校的屋顶观看烟花。

cards.example_en: Cold water from the bottle tasted good after the run.
cards.example_zh: 跑完步后，瓶子里的冷水喝起来真舒服。

cards.example_en: Cold watermelon tastes great in summer.
cards.example_zh: 夏天吃冰西瓜很爽。

cards.example_en: A big wave knocked my little brother off the surfboard.
cards.example_zh: 一个大浪把我弟弟从冲浪板上打了下来。

cards.example_en: The quickest way home is through the park gate.
cards.example_zh: 回家最快的路是穿过公园大门。

cards.example_en: We are learning English together.
cards.example_zh: 我们一起学英语。

cards.example_en: He felt weak and stayed in bed after the flu.
cards.example_zh: 他患流感之后浑身无力，一直躺在床上。

cards.example_en: Health is a kind of wealth.
cards.example_zh: 健康是一种财富。

cards.example_en: Students wear white shirts on Monday at our school.
cards.example_zh: 在我们学校，学生们星期一穿白衬衫。

cards.example_en: What's the weather like today?
cards.example_zh: 今天天气怎么样？

cards.example_en: The library website shows which books are still available.
cards.example_zh: 图书馆网站显示哪些书还可以借。

cards.example_en: This week we have a math test on Thursday.
cards.example_zh: 这个星期我们周四有一场数学测验。

cards.example_en: I get up early on a weekday.
cards.example_zh: 工作日我起得很早。

cards.example_en: I visit my grandparents every weekend and help them cook.
cards.example_zh: 我每个周末都去看望祖父母，还帮他们做饭。

cards.example_en: The nurse will weigh the baby.
cards.example_zh: 护士会给宝宝称体重。

cards.example_en: The weight of my schoolbag hurt my shoulders yesterday.
cards.example_zh: 昨天书包的重量把我的肩膀压疼了。

cards.example_en: We welcome new neighbours with tea and mooncakes.
cards.example_zh: 我们用茶和月饼欢迎新来的邻居。

cards.example_en: She sings very well.
cards.example_zh: 她唱得很好。

cards.example_en: The sun sets in the west behind those tall buildings.
cards.example_zh: 太阳在那些高楼后面的西面落下去。

cards.example_en: My socks were wet after I walked home in the rain.
cards.example_zh: 我冒雨走回家，袜子全湿了。

cards.example_en: A whale swam beside the boat.
cards.example_zh: 一头鲸在船边游过。

cards.example_en: What is your favourite subject?
cards.example_zh: 你最喜欢的科目是什么？

cards.example_en: Choose whatever seat you like.
cards.example_zh: 你喜欢哪个座位就选哪个。

cards.example_en: The front wheel of my bike needs air before the ride.
cards.example_zh: 出门骑车前，我的自行车前轮需要打气。

cards.example_en: When does the train leave?
cards.example_zh: 火车什么时候开？

cards.example_en: Whenever it rains, we play cards in the living room.
cards.example_zh: 一下雨，我们就在客厅里打牌。

cards.example_en: Where is the nearest supermarket?
cards.example_zh: 最近的超市在哪里？

cards.example_en: I don't know whether he will come.
cards.example_zh: 我不知道他会不会来。

cards.example_en: Which colour do you like best?
cards.example_zh: 你最喜欢哪种颜色？

cards.example_en: Don't talk while you are eating.
cards.example_zh: 吃饭时不要说话。

cards.example_en: She wore a white shirt for the school photo.
cards.example_zh: 拍集体照的时候，她穿了一件白衬衫。

cards.example_en: Who is that girl in the red coat?
cards.example_zh: 那个穿红衣服的女孩是谁？

cards.example_en: I spent the whole evening helping Dad cook dinner.
cards.example_zh: 我花了整个晚上帮爸爸做晚饭。

cards.example_en: To whom did you give the letter?
cards.example_zh: 你把这封信给了谁？

cards.example_en: Whose bag is on the chair?
cards.example_zh: 椅子上的包是谁的？

cards.example_en: Why are you late today?
cards.example_zh: 你今天为什么迟到？

cards.example_en: The river is too wide to cross without a bridge.
cards.example_zh: 这条河太宽了，没有桥就过不去。

cards.example_en: His wife is a doctor.
cards.example_zh: 他的妻子是医生。

cards.example_en: We saw wild ducks on the lake behind school.
cards.example_zh: 我们在学校后面的湖上看见了野鸭。

cards.example_en: I will call you after dinner.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭后我会给你打电话。

cards.example_en: Our relay team can win if the last runner starts well.
cards.example_zh: 如果最后一棒起跑顺利，我们的接力队就能赢。

cards.example_en: A cold wind blew my hat off at the bus stop.
cards.example_zh: 公交车站一阵冷风把我的帽子吹掉了。

cards.example_en: Please open the window.
cards.example_zh: 请把窗户打开。

cards.example_en: It is too windy to fly a kite.
cards.example_zh: 风太大，不适合放风筝。

cards.example_en: The bird hurt its left wing and could not fly.
cards.example_zh: 那只鸟伤了左翅膀，飞不起来了。

cards.example_en: The winner of the race received a gold medal.
cards.example_zh: 赛跑的胜者得到了一枚金牌。

cards.example_en: Snow covers the playground all winter at our school.
cards.example_zh: 我们学校的操场整个冬天都盖着雪。

word.example_en: By the way, the library closes at five.
word.example_zh: 顺便说一下，图书馆五点关门。

word.example_en: I bought bread on the way home.
word.example_zh: 我在回家的路上买了面包。

word.example_en: The box can get in the way of the door.
I can skate, and my cousin can skate as well.
She speaks French as well as English.
word.example_zh: 她会说法语，也会说英语。

word.example_en: She can do well in history.
I cannot tell whether it is tea or juice.
word.example_zh: 我分不清那是茶还是果汁。
